t: You're looking at numbers fifty-five and fifty-seven Melbury Road, a pair of buildings in Kensington. They were designed by Halsey Ricardo, an English architect and designer. I don't have much more detail about these two houses to share, so take your time with the facades and the street around you. Melbury Road is worth a slow look, and the buildings here reward close attention to their brickwork, windows and doorways.
